stdout: --url:Rancher server `url` to add and log into; when name is omitted, the server's hostname becomes the entry name
--cacert:PEM CA bundle, a `path` or the literal PEM, saved with the entry (requires --url); when absent, RANCHER_CLI_CACERT connects the login with or without --url, and is never saved
--auth-provider:auth config `name` to sign in with (for example corp-ldap); a provider name or type such as openldap also works; with several matches the CLI asks, or lists them in the error
--no-verify:store the token without an authenticated round-trip against the server

--credential-store:credential `store` this directory keeps its credentials in: auto, keychain, file or exec:<name>; a change of store takes only this entry's credential and needs the other entries logged out of the store being left first
--debug:print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
--no-input:never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
--url:Rancher server `url` to add and log into; when name is omitted, the server's hostname becomes the entry name
